title: Multimodal-Conditioned Latent Diffusion Models for Spatiotemporal Brain MRI Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.25481v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Spatiotemporal forecasting of 3D anatomical changes is a critical generative vision challenge for modeling Alzheimer's Disease (AD) progression. While brain MRI forecasting from single-modality data has advanced, other key complementary multimodal biomarkers remain underutilized. In this work, we propose the Multimodal-Conditioned Latent Diffusion Model (MC-LDM), a novel framework for patient-specific brain MRI synthesis. tldr: 提出多模态条件潜在扩散模型MC-LDM，在训练中融合MRI、tau-PET、CDR和APOE4等多模态生物标志物，推理时仅需基线MRI和APOE4即可合成患者特异性的脑部MRI，用于预测阿尔茨海默病的时空进展。
